subject: Credit note VEN042-0026 – claim timing
body:
Record: VEN042-0026
Finding: VEN042-0026 shows in GSTR-2B for 2025-10, not 2025-09
Why: The supplier reported this invoice one return period late, so its Rs 1,480 of credit can be claimed only in that month.
Entry to make: Claim the credit in the month it appears in GSTR-2B.
Amount involved: Rs 1,480
